title: Young Europeans’ social-network use in 2025
discussion_signal: Eurostat’s post highlights near-universal social-network use among 16–29-year-olds and country variation across the EU. It provides a direct public dissemination signal for the atlas’s age-and-country digital social-world gap.
linked_research_question: How do age and country differences produce distinct digital social worlds despite near-universal youth access?
limits: Social post is a short dissemination summary
Use does not measure quality, wellbeing, or active participation
No causal explanation for country differences
